out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. Observed Hand-sinks without signage.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.EHS provided hand washing handout to be posted in all handsinks.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Roast chicken, roast chicken, rice in unit # 5 at 111, 112, 132F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM reheated Roast chicken, roast chicken, rice from unit # 5 in the oven to 165F, rice was discarded.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed bean and cheese filling pupusas in unit # 1 at 50F, beans and cheese pupusa filling in unit # 2, Cut tomato ( salad), cut lettuce ( salad), pico de gallo on ice - serve well at 50, 64, 58F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded bean and cheese filling pupusas from unit # 1, beans and cheese pupusa filling from unit # 2. CFM discarded Cut tomato ( salad), cut lettuce ( salad), pico de gallo on ice

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: WIR gaskets are not in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CFM will replace the WIR gaskets. MR POLLO (Inspection Date: 09/16/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair

violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. CFM will call plumber to repair the leaking.
